# Fixtures for `ttml` (TTML timed text)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The text is a script
for a fictitious harbour documentary; names, places and hosts (Saltmere, Ana Lighthouse, Ben Gull,
Mira Castell, `*.example`) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/subtitles.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `harbour-ebu-tt-crafted.ttml` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: EBU-TT style, times in ticks and frames, nested time containers, agents | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-ffmpeg.ttml` | ffmpeg 7.1 (`ttml` muxer) | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-pycaption.dfxp` | pycaption 2.3.14 (DFXP writer) | CC0-1.0 |
